desc: Derive the fixed-\(H\) feasible interval and reduce the grinding cost to maximizing \(H\).
Establish interval propagation as a correct \(O(N)\) feasibility test for \(|A_i-A_{i+1}|\le X\).
Prove feasibility monotonicity and valid binary-search bounds \(0\le H\le\min_i(U_i+D_i)\).
Implement and validate the complete Python solution, including edge cases and required output formatting.
